conversation.content: Test Insurance provider line, Marcus B. speaking. How can I help you today?
Hi Marcus, this is Alex T. calling from Test Clinic about eligibility verification for Test Patient. May I have your last initial?
I just told you, I'm Marcus B. Were you not listening? Anyway, what's the tax ID?
I apologize for that, Marcus. The tax ID is twelve dash three four five six seven eight nine.
And the member's name and date of birth?
The member's name is Test Patient and the date of birth is January fifteenth, nineteen ninety.
Let me pull that up... Got it. They're active, in network. What else do you need?
Could you please provide the type of plan for Test Patient?
Sure! The type of plan for Test Patient is a comprehensive health plan. Is there anything else you need?
Could you specify the plan type as PPO, HMO, POS, EPO, or HDHP?
The plan type for Test Patient is an HMO plan. Is there anything else you would like to know?
What is the effective date of the plan?
The effective date of the plan is March 1, 2023. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Is there a termination date for the plan?
The termination date for the plan is December 31, 2024. Do you need any more information?
I need to verify coverage for CPT code nine nine two one three. Can you confirm if this service is covered?
Let me check that for you... Yes, the service for CPT code 99213 is covered under the plan. Is there anything else you need?
What is the copay for this service?
The copay for CPT code 99213 is $25. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Is there a coinsurance for this service?
No, there is no coinsurance for this service. The copay of $25 is the only cost associated with it. Do you have any other questions?
Does the deductible apply to this service?
No, the deductible does not apply to this service. The copay of $25 covers it fully. Is there anything else you would like to know?
Is prior authorization required for this service?
No, prior authorization is not required for this service. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Is telehealth covered for this service?
Yes, telehealth is covered for this service. Is there anything else you need?
Could you provide the individual and family deductible amounts, as well as any amounts met?

The individual deductible is $1,500, and the family deductible is $3,000. Currently, $500 has been met for the individual, and $1,000 has been met for the family. Is there anything else I can help with?
What is the individual out-of-pocket maximum?
The individual out-of-pocket maximum is $3,500. Is there anything else you would like to know?
How much of the individual out-of-pocket maximum has been met?
$1,000 has been met of the individual out-of-pocket maximum. Do you need any more information?
What is the family out-of-pocket maximum?
The family out-of-pocket maximum is $7,000. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
How much of the family out-of-pocket maximum has been met?
$2,000 has been met of the family out-of-pocket maximum. Is there anything else you would like to know?
May I have a reference number for this call?
Sure! Your reference number for this call is 987654321. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Thank you for your help. Goodbye!
